scope: Exact authorized manual gate, isolated branch concurrency, configurable FPM guard, step-only Cloudflare credentials, and phase evidence; main operational steps retained. PR67 fixture/negative approach is reference only, not merged.

deltas.before:
- main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('law-validation-pr-{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || 'production-deploy' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
deltas.after:
- main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      candidate_sha:
        description: Exact main commit with successful isolated Linux validation
        required: true
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('law-validation-pr-{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' && format('law-validation-dispatch-{0}', github.run_id) || 'production-deploy') }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:

deltas.before:
with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Generate content-addressed Fokus Law assets for tests
        run: npm run law:assets:prepare
deltas.after:
with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Test fail-closed FPM workflow integration without network
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/Deployment -p 'test_fpm*.py' -v

      - name: Test manual publication gate without GitHub or server access
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/Deployment -p 'test_publication_gate.py' -v

      - name: Generate content-addressed Fokus Law assets for tests
        run: npm run law:assets:prepare

run: npm run seo:check

  deploy:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && needs.validate.result == 'success' && needs.classify.result == 'success' && needs.classify.outputs.docs_only == 'false'
    name: Publish Laravel application
    needs: [validate, classify]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    env:
      DEPLOY_PUBLIC_BASE_URL: ${{ vars.DEPLOY_PUBLIC_BASE_URL }}
      DEPLOY_RELEASE_URL: ${{ vars.DEPLOY_RELEASE_URL }}
      FPM_RELOAD_MODE: ${{ vars.FPM_RELOAD_MODE }}

deltas.before:
EXPECTED_RELEASE: ${{ github.sha }}
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      # Intentionally fail before SSH or schema mutations until an independently
      # reviewed, dynamic release endpoint and runtime policy are configured.
deltas.after:
EXPECTED_RELEASE: ${{ github.sha }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Node for immutable Fokus Law assets
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Generate immutable assets and one-shot deploy payload
        run: node tools/generate-fokus-law-assets.mjs --output-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --staging-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/fokus-law-assets"

      - name: Require exact main revision and latest successful Linux validation
        id: publication
        env:
          EXPECTED_CANDIDATE: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 deploy/publication_gate.py

      # Intentionally fail before SSH or schema mutations until an independently
      # reviewed, dynamic release endpoint and runtime policy are configured.

deltas.before:
run: |
          python3 tools/ci/verify-deployment.py preflight
          python3 tools/ci/verify-deployment.py probe-current

      - name: Setup Node for immutable Fokus Law assets
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Generate immutable assets and one-shot deploy payload
        run: node tools/generate-fokus-law-assets.mjs --output-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --staging-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/fokus-law-assets"

      - name: Configure SSH
        id: ssh
deltas.after:
run: |
          python3 tools/ci/verify-deployment.py preflight
          python3 tools/ci/verify-deployment.py probe-current

      - name: Configure SSH
        id: ssh

deltas.before:
printf '%s\n' "$DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS" > ~/.ssh/known_hosts
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/known_hosts
          ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=20 -o ConnectionAttempts=1 -p "$DEPLOY_PORT" "$DEPLOY_USER@$DEPLOY_HOST" exit

      - name: Verify Law schema before publishing application code
        id: schema
deltas.after:
printf '%s\n' "$DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS" > ~/.ssh/known_hosts
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/known_hosts
          ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=20 -o ConnectionAttempts=1 -p "$DEPLOY_PORT" "$DEPLOY_USER@$DEPLOY_HOST" exit

      - name: Preflight selected FPM policy before any remote mutation
        id: fpm_preflight
        timeout-minutes: 2
        env:
          DEPLOY_HOST: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_HOST }}
          DEPLOY_PORT: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_PORT }}
          DEPLOY_USER: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_USER }}
        run: python3 deploy/fpm_guard_cli.py preflight

      - name: Verify Law schema before publishing application code
        id: schema

deltas.before:
DEPLOY_HOST: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_HOST }}
          DEPLOY_PORT: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_PORT }}
          DEPLOY_USER: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_USER }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Preflight validates these exact, bounded arguments before any mutation.
          # No restart fallback, privilege change, or swallowed SSH exit status.
          ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=20 -o ConnectionAttempts=1 -p "$DEPLOY_PORT" "$DEPLOY_USER@$DEPLOY_HOST" \
            "bash -s -- '$FPM_RELOAD_MODE' '$FPM_SERVICE'" < deploy/reload-runtime.sh

      - name: Purge Cloudflare cache
        id: cdn
        if: ${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN != '' && env.CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID != '' }}
        run: |
          curl --fail-with-body --request POST \
            "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/purge_cache" \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" \
deltas.after:
DEPLOY_HOST: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_HOST }}
          DEPLOY_PORT: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_PORT }}
          DEPLOY_USER: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_USER }}
        run: python3 deploy/fpm_guard_cli.py activate

      - name: Purge Cloudflare cache
        id: cdn
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" ] || [ -z "$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID" ]; then
            echo "Cloudflare purge not configured; skipping."
            echo "result=skipped" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          curl --fail-with-body --request POST \
            "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/purge_cache" \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" \
